objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document; assignment can be adapted to different requirements.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning author authorization; the Creator of a document is automatically confirmed in this field by default.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used for assigning releasers.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned with releaser for translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is counted; updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used with Valid From to calculate Valid Until; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing User Groups and persons regarding e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose later change affects existing User Groups and persons regarding workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type that describes locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type that describes specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document special detailed work steps that would go beyond the scope of a procedural instruction.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating new documents; can have document templates and settings.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create a new document or to add additional information or an attachment to a document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document associated with a main document; automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement documents with additional information; released and published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Entity with which documents can be linked; example given is IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using the system, assigned roles, authorizations and workflow tasks.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader access, roles, distribution and authorizations.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned specifically to documents to assign read and change rights.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role whose users can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role whose users are offered in author or co-author selection lists and receive read and write permissions when assigned.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned additional change rights on a document and able to start the release process.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document and its content and for deciding whether the document is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language and cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing for approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement and translation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to users during workflows; users are informed of status and existence by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks; documented for each released version.

objs.name: version
objs.description: Version of a document created by release, revision, changes, attachments or reactivation.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that can be created without affecting content or version history and belongs to a document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system 30 days before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing User Groups and persons for distribution, acknowledgement and dashboards.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that is workflow-supported without a signature.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled according to distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a corresponding document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that retains read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more templates defined for the document type when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or generating new documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to the object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web or in dashboards.

evts.name: change_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign a user as author of a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers maintained in document attributes.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers maintained in document attributes.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Create an Attachment associated with a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Start the 3-step release process after document creation, maintenance and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete release to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform users involved of workflow status, workflow tasks, proposals, validity extension, override, distribution or acknowledgement by e-mail.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document individual participants' signatures in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before the Valid until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the validity extension request with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request and update the Valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow after attaching the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_aks
evts.description: Check the AKS request and document in workflow steps.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force; set the last valid approved version to Out of force and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalid documents and attachments by withdrawing authorizations.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the reactivation workflow.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring maintained authorizations.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain User Groups and persons on the Distribution list for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status or acknowledgements using reports and dashboards.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to the original document from an extended local document.

o2o.description: A new document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be generated based on a selected template.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released with it.
Additional information can be added to each document.
External files or documents can be uploaded to a document object cover.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with other documents and referenced documents are displayed.
Documents can be linked to Master data.
Documents can be linked with IT applications.
User Groups can be assigned to a document for readers, distribution, authorizations and dashboards.
Persons can be assigned to a document for roles and distribution.
Authorization groups are assigned specifically to documents.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
Reader - Document Management is implemented as a system role User Group.
Users assigned to Authors User Groups are offered in author or co-author selection lists.
Users assigned to Reviewer User Groups are offered in the reviewer selection list.
Users assigned to the releaser user group are offered in the releaser selection list.
A document has a registered author.
Co-authors can be assigned to a document.
Reviewers can be maintained on a document.
Releasers can be maintained on a document.
Readers may view approved documents assigned to them.
Participants for translation checking and release are assigned in the properties dialog of the document.
Workflow tasks exist within workflow processing.
Workflow tasks are assigned to and completed by users.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released document version and can be printed as document content.
Documents are managed in versions and have released or editing versions.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
A Distribution list is maintained for the document.
User Groups can be assigned to the Distribution list.
Persons can be assigned directly to the Distribution list.
Acknowledgements relate to the current document version.
Relevant documents are listed in dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
For each document in a multi-client system, clients can be specified in which it is visible or not.
Users in the Archive group still have read access to archived documents.
Only the Business Admin group is permitted to create requests for reactivation.
